info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Deposit Switch Retrieval API
info.description: The Deposit Switch Retrieval API enables businesses to access and manage the deposit switch configurations associated with external transfer transactions. By using this API, developers can retrieve the current deposit switch settings for a specific external transaction identified by its external ID. This functionality is particularly useful for financial institutions and payment processing systems looking to enhance their transaction management capabilities and provide better service to their customers. Typical use cases include audits, reporting, and integration into user-facing applications to display or modify deposit options.

get.summary: Retrieve deposit switches for an external resource.
get.description: Fetches the deposit switches associated with the specified external resource, allowing for effective management and operations pertaining to deposits.
